text:
- [LTES.12.9] **Rule-firing order is spec-defined, not implementation-
  defined.** When multiple activations match at the same
  clock instant, the order they fire in is the total order of
  [LDET.5.1] — the terminal ordinal, which is source order, then
  activation-creation order within one rule. No dependence on hash
  ordering, and none on the order matches happen to COMPLETE:
  which is why the ordinal is the first key and not the last.
  Restates [LTES.5.4.2].

idris.name: ldet_5_9__ordered_recompute
idris.note: Within one rule the firing order is a function of the matches and of working memory -- the same for every implementation and for a from-scratch build; nothing depends on the order matches happen to complete inside the engine.
